upstream_job.name: upstream-hdl / Original testbenches for 29 pinned designs

upstream_source.acquisition: Project staged by probe_upstream_testbenches.py from its integrity-verified source acquisition.

limits: One upstream default parameter configuration is selected for each peripheral bench; this is not the entire upstream parameter matrix.
PicoRV32 runs through two original simulator entrypoints and counts as one physical design.
SERV and Ibex Simple System are directed firmware/system smoke checks; they do not establish exhaustive ISA or UVM coverage.
The complete nv_small top runs four original golden-CRC traces; the separate SystemC/UVM C-model cross-check remains external and unverified.
The isolated upstream dependency profiles are tested on Linux x64; unrelated platform tool discovery does not establish original bench execution.

prior_dependency_failure.stage: Install native upstream driver and generator prerequisites
prior_dependency_failure.cause: The runner image Microsoft APT feed returned 403 before any original bench ran. The repaired job disables only that unused feed and retains Ubuntu signature checks.
